cards.title: Check in with Corpus Departure
cards.leadIn: At 500 ft MSL, when directed by Tower:

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Departure, <callsign>, 500 feet off Navy Corpus, course rules Ingleside.

exchange.speaker: Departure
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Departure, radar contact <distance and direction> of Navy Corpus. Proceed course rules Ingleside.

cards.detail: The binder shows the Rusty check-in for Kings 4 and Goliad; the Ingleside phrase follows it. Check with an instructor.
cards.source: Binder, pp. 8, 56–58; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slide 88.
